style: 3D animated feature-film look like a big-studio family movie still (Pixar-style): expressive stylized characters with big warm eyes, soft global illumination, rich warm colors, cinematic golden lighting, detailed storybook sets.
priest: a kind elderly Coptic Orthodox priest with a short gray beard, wearing a black robe and a black hood (eiskeem) with small white embroidered crosses, holding a small Coptic hand cross
tail: 16:9 wide shot, no text, no logos, no readable writing on screens.

images.scene: Wide shot of the entrance of a beautiful Coptic Orthodox church on a Sunday morning, happy Egyptian-Coptic families with children in their Sunday best streaming through the open doors, golden morning light, a stone cross above the door.

{priest}, sitting at a wooden desk at night under a warm lamp, surrounded by paper attendance lists and a phone full of contacts, looking thoughtful and a little overwhelmed, a Coptic icon on the wall behind him.

A young Egyptian-Coptic mother sitting on a bench in a church lobby, smiling as she creates her profile on her smartphone, her toddler beside her holding a toy, warm candle glow and icons in the background.

{priest} and a young male servant placing a sleek tablet kiosk on an elegant dark wooden floor stand just inside the church doors, both smiling and giving a thumbs up, golden light through the doorway.

A Coptic family of four (father, mother, a girl and a boy) at a sleek tablet kiosk on a wooden floor stand just inside the church doors; the father looks at the tablet with a friendly smile, a glowing green check on the tablet, the kids waving happily, candles and icons behind them.
A cheerful young man at a church entrance holding up his smartphone to scan a square code shown on a tablet kiosk, a soft beam of golden light between the phone and the tablet.
A teenage girl typing three numbers on her smartphone in a church lobby while her friend beside her points at a kiosk tablet showing a big three-digit number, both smiling.
{priest}, smiling gently at a laptop in a calm church office, friendly colorful charts glowing on the laptop screen, an icon of the Virgin and Child on the wall, a cup of tea on the desk.
Three church servants (a young man, a young woman and an older lady) gathered around a tablet at a table in a church hall, smiling and helping each other, children's drawings on the wall, warm light.
{priest}, on a phone call with a warm caring smile, sitting in a cozy office with a handwritten notebook and a small candle, evening light.
A small birthday celebration for a boy in a Coptic church hall, servants and children gathered around a cake with candles, balloons, joyful warm atmosphere.
Two friendly Coptic Orthodox priests in black robes and black hoods standing side by side in front of two different small church buildings, each holding a golden key, shaking hands, sunny sky.
{priest}, warmly greeting a returning Coptic family of four at the church door in soft golden morning light, the mother holds a child's hand, joyful and peaceful.
